conflict_count.description: Fields both documents carry that disagree after canonicalization.

identities.description: The three identities of spec section 4.2a.

flow_map_lineage.description: Lineage of the supplied flow map; null when none was supplied.

flow_map.description: Spec section 4.2 and decision 9. Always carries supplied, export_sha256 and export_flow_map_path; when a map was supplied, also its filename, sha256, lineage, application, application_matches and the resolved and unresolved node component ids.

completeness.description: Spec section 5: how many nodes reached each context grade, from component_bound down to unbound.

mitigation_coverage.description: Stage N3c totals across every node: covered, total, how many nodes have a focus cut, and any M-ID the reference data does not carry.

taxonomy.description: Stage N3d: counts of technique: and tactic: statuses against ATT&CK v19.2.

engagement.description: Actor, application, ATT&CK version and model attribution read from provenance.model.

inventory.description: Paths, node count and the ordered node keys.

nodes.description: One entry per attack step, keyed by (projection_identity, path_id, node_index).

context_completeness.description: Stage N3a. What a later draft may claim for this node.

control_catalogue.description: Stage N3b, decision 10. Controls attached to this node: structurally from the flow map's component, or by control name plus the component id named in a catalogue entry's description, marked evidence 'text'.

mitigations_covered.description: Stage N3c. mitigations minus uncovered_mitigations, each with its resolved name and technique breadth. A tagged control exists on this component, so a draft here is a tuning case.

mitigation_focus.description: Stage N3c, section 1.4b. The one or two narrowest uncovered mitigations by technique breadth, ties broken by M-ID. Narrows what generation reasons about; never an argument that a detection should exist. Empty is ordinary.

mitigation_names.description: M-ID to name, resolved locally from mitre_relationships.json. An id absent from the reference data is reported in mitigation_coverage.unresolved, never named.

mitigation_coverage.description: covered, total, unresolved, and tag_caveat: the control-tagging counts recomputed from the supplied flow map (decision 11), or null with tag_caveat_reason when no map was supplied. A null caveat never means every control is tagged.

technique_status.description: Stage N3d against v19.2. A remap adds technique_id_current and technique_remap_basis; the export's technique_id is never rewritten.

tactic_status.description: Stage N3d. 'reconciled' carries tactic_as_supplied; 'unresolved' keeps the export value untouched.

monitoring_claim.description: Derived from detecting_controls and detection_capability. A claim about what is watched, never coverage.

warnings.description: Codes from the closed catalogue of spec section 4.4.
